About the Official Plan
The Official Plan is our city's long-term planning guide for land use and development. It will be reviewed and updated periodically to ensure it reflects changing conditions in the city.
If you have questions about the plan, or require it in an alternate format, contact our Planning division, at
519-747-8752
or
devservices@waterloo.ca
.

Appendix - Area Specific Policies
The online version is a consolidation of policies in effect as of December 2025. It is for ease of reference only. For the official version, use the original Plan and Plan Amendments on file with the City Clerk and Ontario Land Tribunal (previously OMB or LPAT).

Region of Waterloo Official Plan
On January 1, 2025, the Province shifted most regional planning duties to local municipalities. Until the city updates its Official Plan and repeals the Region’s plan, both plans apply within Waterloo.
If you have questions about how the Region’s Official Plan applies to development in the City of Waterloo, refer to the consolidated Regional Official Plan or contact
devservices@waterloo.ca
with any questions.
